nodes.name: BUILD RAW DATA LOG ROWS
nodes.notes:
Multi-source aggregation (receipts + event CSVs + existing sheet rows), hence Code. Matches the Intercom UI's Performance Summary: Total sent = emails sent in the week; opened/clicked/replied/unsubscribed/bounced = distinct delivered emails with that event inside the week, whenever the email was sent (so rates can exceed 100%). 

Every email of a series with any activity gets a row, zeros included. Series with 'test' in the title are skipped. Known gap: events on emails sent more than ~80 days earlier cannot be attributed (90-day export cap), typically +/-1 versus the UI.

parameters.content:
## Intercom Series Performance to Spreadsheet

**Purpose:**
- This automation extracts weekly email series performance data from Intercom and appends it to the RAW Data Log in the LeadGen Tracking spreadsheet.

- The workflow retrieves performance data for Live production series, excludes test series, and calculates the required metrics for the previous week using Intercom’s export data. It maps metrics such as total sent, opens, clicks, replies, unsubscribes, and bounces into the spreadsheet.

- The automation also includes duplicate prevention, proper formatting for dates, counts, and percentages, and retry handling when an Intercom export is already running. This replaces the current manual process of exporting and copying data for each series individually.

## Documentation
This will run every monday, :
- 6:00 AM BST OR 1:00 PM PHT

- If a series had any activity that week, all its email get a row, including zero rows.

- Series with no activity at all week get no rows.

- Series with test in the title are skipped
Avoid naming the series with "test" in it, e.g., "Testimonial," "Latest," etc.
 
- Series are not filtered by live status (the api doesn’t expose it). In practice only live series have weekly activity.

- No duplicates: before appending, it skips any row where date + series id + series name already exists, so re-runs are safe.
